content.title: When Is the Masters Golf Tournament in 2026?
content.text: Every spring, the world’s best golfers converge on Augusta National Golf Club for one of the most iconic events in sports: The Masters Tournament. If you're already planning ahead for 2026, or just dreaming of being part of the excitement, it’s time to pencil in the dates and prepare for an unforgettable experience in Augusta, Georgia. 2026 Masters Tournament Dates The 2026 Masters Tournament will be held Monday, April 6 through Sunday, April 12, 2026. While the main tournament runs from Thursday to Sunday (April 9–12), the week is filled with events, practice rounds, and the beloved Par 3 Contest, making it a full seven days of golf tradition and Southern hospitality. Key Events During Masters Week Here's a quick look at what typically happens each day: Monday, April 6: Practice rounds begin. Patrons get their first look at the course and players. Tuesday, April 7: Another day of practice and often player interviews. Wednesday, April 8: The fan-favorite Par 3 Contest, where pros play a fun, short course with family and friends as caddies. Thursday–Sunday, April 9–12: The Masters Tournament officially begins, culminating in the Green Jacket ceremony on Sunday evening. Whether you have tickets or are just visiting Augusta to soak in the atmosphere, this week offers something special for everyone. Why the Masters Is More Than Just a Golf Tournament The Masters isn't just about birdies and bunkers—it’s about tradition, prestige, and the unique charm of Augusta. From the iconic azaleas in bloom to the roaring cheers echoing across Amen Corner, the tournament is a bucket-list event for sports fans around the globe. And for the city of Augusta, it’s more than just golf. It’s a time when local businesses thrive, families reunite, and visitors from all walks of life experience the best the city has to offer.
